name: Breaker timing measurement interface
aliases: switchgear Switchgear test and commissioning interfaces
summary: Collects the selected operation timing signals for a documented breaker timing assessment.
description: Collects the selected operation timing signals for a documented breaker timing assessment. A test interface separates measurement, command and indication paths so their behavior can be checked in the documented test configuration. The test boundary must show which real equipment outputs remain enabled.

In a switchgear relay panel, test links can separate a protective relay from the trip coils while maintaining the specified current-transformer secondary arrangement. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Command and contact events” at the input and “Timing measurement inputs” at the output. Contact timing is not inferred from an auxiliary alone.

Trace the source and destination on each side of the test boundary. Use the selected test-device instructions for actual operations and never infer a safe current-transformer switching sequence from an educational diagram. Equipment-specific ratings, terminal connections and operating conditions must be established in the project documentation.
